title: Rutile readiness attestation v1
description: Independent readiness attestation v1. An ed25519 attestation, signed by an independent trusted verifier over the readiness domain, covering the full probe bundle (source commit/tree, runner lock ref and hash, all 14 attested probes with evidence refs/hashes and observation timestamps, actionable blockers) plus issued/expiry timestamps and verifier identity/fingerprint/independence evidence. The verifier key, operator, and provisioning host must be distinct from the release authority; the release-authority key/fingerprint is rejected as a readiness verifier under any domain. readiness != publication: this attestation asserts release-readiness only and does NOT authorize publication, tagging, release, or public distribution, and does not set or imply publication_authorized (which remains structurally false in artifact-inspection v1).

generated_at_unix_ms.description: Unix-epoch millisecond timestamp. Bounded by 2^53 to stay exactly representable as a JSON number (double-precision float).

runner_lock_ref.description: Repository-relative reference to the authenticated Forgejo runner-lock record bound to this attestation.

probes.description: Exactly the 14 release-readiness probes, each appearing exactly once, each 'attested' with a 1:1 evidence reference and SHA-256.

actionable_blockers.description: Actionable blockers remaining against this attestation. A valid 'ready' attestation must have an empty list; a non-empty list denotes an incomplete readiness state and is never a publication pass.

verifier.description: The independent trusted verifier that signed this attestation. Its key, operator, and provisioning host must be distinct from the release authority; the release-authority key/fingerprint must be rejected here under any domain.

ready.description: True only when the attestation is complete: all 14 probes attested with matching evidence, the canonical message verifies against the trusted-verifier public key under the readiness domain, the verifier fingerprint is distinct from the release-authority fingerprint, and actionable_blockers is empty.

disclaimer.const: This readiness attestation asserts release-readiness only. It does not authorize publication, does not clear the release-prerequisite preflight, does not set or imply publication_authorized, and does not permit tagging, releasing, or publicly distributing the product.

allOf.description: Internal consistency: a 'ready' attestation cannot carry actionable blockers.
Converse consistency: a not-ready attestation must carry at least one actionable blocker, mirroring the code's NotReadyWithoutBlockers invariant.

gitSha40.description: 40-character lowercase hexadecimal git object id (commit or tree).

logicalId.description: Repository-relative logical identifier or evidence path. Rejects absolute paths, traversal, host-local prefixes, private/loopback addresses, and secret-looking material.

state.description: Every probe in a readiness attestation must be 'attested'. The historical 'unavailable'/'failed'/'not_required' states belong only to the v1 preflight and are rejected here.

evidence_ref.description: Repository-relative reference to the single observation backing this probe. 1:1 with evidence_sha256.

ed25519PublicKey.description: 32-byte ed25519 verifying key as 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

ed25519Signature.description: 64-byte ed25519 signature as 128 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

identity.description: Logical identity of the independent trusted verifier (distinct operator and provisioning host from the release authority).

key_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of the verifier's 32-byte ed25519 public key, as 64 lowercase hex characters (mirrors release_authority.rs key_fingerprint). Must differ from the release-authority key fingerprint; equality is a hard rejection at verification time.

independence_evidence_ref.description: Repository-relative reference to the evidence record proving independence: distinct operator, distinct provisioning host, separately generated key, and no shared credential with the release authority.

domain.description: Exact domain-separation tag prefixed to the canonical message before signing. NUL bytes (�) are part of the tag. Distinct from the preview-publication-authorization domain; a readiness attestation signed under any other domain is invalid.

canonical_message_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the domain-separated canonical message that was signed, so a reviewer can confirm the exact bytes covered by signature_hex.

expires_at_unix_ms.description: Expiry of this attestation. A stale attestation (current time past expiry) must not be accepted as readiness evidence. Unix-epoch milliseconds bounded by 2^53 (JSON-safe).
